hooks.command: ${env:-eval "case \$(uname -s) in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) exec powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"\$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/handoff.ps1\";; *) if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec node \"\$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/handoff.mjs\"; fi;; esac; exit 0"}; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/handoff.ps1"
